svg.title: DIA-401 · A Double-Edged Knife
svg.desc: A coastal chart. A jagged coastline runs from top to bottom: the frontier of what the AI does well. To the left is land, marked with small towns for tasks and three large figures: 12.2 percent more tasks finished, 25.1 percent faster, and quality up 40 percent and more. To the right is open water, ruled with fading water lines and marked with rust crosses for wrecks, and one large rust figure: minus 19, the percentage points by which consultants using AI were less likely to get the answer right. A dashed line of latitude runs through one town and one wreck that sit level with each other, two tasks that look equally hard. A compass rose sits in the lower right. From a preregistered field experiment of 758 consultants.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 1 · DOES IT MAKE YOU BETTER?
one latitude, two tasks that look
equally hard: one ashore, one lost
ASHORE: WHAT THE AI DOES WELL
and more, in the quality of the work
A survey of 758 consultants, assigned by chance
DIA-401 · One tool, one study: better work ashore of a jagged frontier, worse answers in the water beyond it.
